name: Nakayama (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Nakayama town emblem in white: an outlined ring divided by a vertical stroke, enclosing stylised strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nakayama, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 August 1955.

features.role: Nakayama town emblem — an outlined ring divided by a vertical stroke, enclosing stylised strokes
